items.title: 1. Front wall fan of vertical stripes
items.evidence: 1_beauty az000: cream face is a clean flat bowl with 3-4 facets, no needle fan; 3_tech az000 wall grey, no yellow.

items.title: 2. Belly bowl twice reference height
items.evidence: 1_beauty az090/back34: cream is a thin strip under the rim (~15-20% of body height), matches 5_reference side split.

items.title: 3. Eye stalks are lollipops
items.evidence: 1_beauty az000/hero and 2_closeups eyes: balls sit on the rim on a short socket stalk, no tall thin stick; wire shows buried root.

items.title: 4. Claw tips dark blocks / near claw lump
items.evidence: 1_beauty hero: dark zone is now a tip cap and fingers read separately; but az000 still shows large black wedges on the inner side of each claw, and 5_reference front pair shows tips much smaller.

items.title: 5. Legs too short and flat
items.evidence: 5_reference top: reach is close to sheet; but 1_beauty az000/back34 legs still slope straight from hip as constant boxes, no arched knees near rim height.

regressions: 3_tech/techqa clip count is 4 (eyes 2, rim teeth 2); eye clip tris are new but tiny (0.0004 area), gates ok
